input: Sign up for an improv comedy writing workshop

gold.taskTitle: Sign Up for an Improv Comedy Writing Workshop
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to find and register for an improv comedy writing workshop.

questions.title: Are you looking for an in-person or online workshop?
questions.description: Determine the preferred format of the workshop — in-person attendance or a virtual/online option.

questions.title: What city or region should the workshop be in?
questions.description: Identify the geographic location relevant to the user for finding nearby in-person options.

questions.title: Do you have a deadline or preferred start date?
questions.description: Understand when the user wants the workshop to begin or if they need to enroll by a certain date.

questions.title: What is your experience level with improv or comedy writing?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user is a complete beginner, intermediate, or has prior experience to match the right workshop level.

questions.title: How much are you willing to spend on this workshop?
questions.description: Establish a budget range so workshop options can be filtered by cost.

questions.title: Are you more focused on improv performance or written comedy?
questions.description: Determine whether the primary interest is in live improv techniques, comedy scriptwriting, or a blend of both.

questions.title: Do you prefer a single session or a multi-week course?
questions.description: Find out if the user wants a one-time workshop experience or an ongoing series of classes.
